desc: Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 08/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Update on board meeting

we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works Limited (the 'Company') at their meeting held on Tuesday, September 08, 2026, inter-alia, has considered and approved following transactions:
(a) Approval of Board's Report for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026
(b) 11th Annual General Meeting for the FY 2025-26 
(c)Approval for issuance of Non-Convertible Debenture up to Rs. 500 Crores
(d) Approval for Alteration of Memorandum of Association pursuant to sub-division of the Equity Shares
